description: Union Government of India: total spending by ministry/department. Expenditure Budget Vol. 1 Statement 2 (Plan/Non-plan) up to 2016-17; Expenditure Profile Statement 3/3A (Revenue/Capital, with scheme categories) from 2017-18. Department ids are kept across renames via data_maps/ministry_names.csv.
comparability: Up to 2016-17 a department's line excludes State Plan assistance routed through it (listed separately as state_plans:<id>); from 2017-18 it is included. Several demands were split or merged in 2017-18 (see the name map notes).
